title: Prannoy, Unnati Lead Indian Challenge at Taipei Open Super 300
indian_angle: Top Indian shuttlers HS Prannoy and Unnati Hooda are set to represent India at the upcoming Taipei Open, carrying the nation's hopes for a strong performance.
summary: Seventh seed HS Prannoy, a 2023 Asian Games and world championships bronze medallist, will open against Japan’s Minoru Koga, while third seed Unnati Hooda will begin against a qualifier in the women’s singles round of 32.

title: Sindhu, Shetty Exit China Open Super 1000 After Wasting Match Points
indian_angle: India's top shuttlers PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty faced early exits from the prestigious China Open Super 1000, disappointing fans.
summary: PV Sindhu frittered away four match points in her loss to Chen Yufei, while Ayush Shetty also failed to convert match points, leading to their respective exits from the China Open Super 1000.

title: Ayush Shetty Triumphs Over Alwi Farhan at China Open
indian_angle: Young Indian talent Ayush Shetty secured a significant victory against Malaysia's Alwi Farhan at the China Open, showcasing his potential on the international stage.
summary: Indian rising star Ayush Shetty defeated Malaysia's Alwi Farhan in a closely watched match at the China Open, marking a notable win for the young shuttler.

title: PV Sindhu Claims Japan Open Title, Defeating Akane Yamaguchi
indian_angle: PV Sindhu's triumphant win at the Japan Open, securing a major title against a strong home opponent, marks a significant return to form for the Indian star.
summary: PV Sindhu ended her title drought by winning the Japan Open, overcoming local favourite Akane Yamaguchi in a scorching final performance, a victory that brought tears to her eyes.

title: All India Senior Ranking Tournament Concludes in Chennai
indian_angle: The Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament in Chennai provided a crucial platform for top Indian shuttlers to compete domestically.
summary: The Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2026 was held in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, from July 16th to 23rd, serving as a key event for senior players in the national circuit.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India's decision to implement a 3x15 scoring system in junior domestic tournaments will significantly impact the development and strategy of young Indian shuttlers.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups, aiming to debut the format in Ernakulam.
